business_problem: 37 Interactive Entertainment's legacy intelligent customer service stack struggled to understand gaming slang and fast-changing subculture knowledge, forcing agents to search fragmented knowledge bases manually and miss service-level targets.
solution_summary: 37 Interactive Entertainment rebuilt its game-support stack on Baidu AI Cloud using large models and retrieval-augmented generation. Qianfan ModelBuilder was used to tune prompts and semantic understanding for gaming slang and subculture terms, while Qianfan AppBuilder orchestrated RAG flows that combined the existing service knowledge base with player behavior data and a dynamic knowledge graph. Baidu AI Cloud Keyue Intelligent Customer Service became the frontline support layer, binding common intents such as password recovery or event-rule questions to standard prompt templates for fast answers. More complex issues, including bug and recharge cases, triggered multi-turn dialogues to collect device and scenario details before the system called technical-team interfaces to create tickets. Unresolved conversations were clustered and reviewed so prompts, constraints, and tone controls could be updated continuously.
products_used: Baidu AI Cloud Keyue Intelligent Customer Service

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model and prompt-iteration environment used to improve semantic understanding for gaming-specific language and workflows.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Orchestrates the RAG customer-service flows that combine prompts, knowledge retrieval, and multi-turn issue handling.

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Keyue Intelligent Customer Service
solution_components.role: Runs the frontline game-support experience that answers common requests and escalates complex cases to downstream teams.

data_flow: Player questions enter Baidu AI Cloud Keyue, where Qianfan AppBuilder routes them through RAG workflows that retrieve the customer-service knowledge base, player behavior data, and the dynamic knowledge graph. Qianfan ModelBuilder-backed prompts then generate answers, while complex issues trigger multi-turn clarification and ticket creation through technical-team interfaces.
business_outcome: The rebuilt assistant delivered more human-like answers, reduced manual escalations on unclear player requests, and lifted SLA attainment from 61% to 99.3% while improving complex-issue diversion accuracy.
metrics: SLA attainment increased 38.3 percentage points to 99.3%.
The original semantic-understanding accuracy for gaming-community language was 62.3%.
New customer service hires previously needed hundreds of hours of specialized training.
Response delays caused by retrieval mistakes reached 2300+ minutes per month.
